contributions.name: SonarQube Cloud Security
contributions.description: Read SonarQube Cloud security issues, hotspots, quality gates, and coding rules
contributions.instructions: Provide a least-privilege SonarQube user token and organization key. The token is sent only as a bearer authorization header and is never shown in the interface, logs, or tool output. Do not enable issue, hotspot, rule, project, or quality-gate mutations.
